zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增歌曲版本管理：重复音频自动归组为同一首歌的多个版本，可在歌曲详情中切换、设为首选、拆分或撤销；播放自动跳过缺失文件，也可移除缺失记录。曲库升级前自动备份，并按标题、专辑和艺术家重新关联已有歌曲
• 首页推荐新增「相似听感」「好久没听」栏目，轮播、侧卡与「为你推荐」共用队列；换批计入近期曝光以减少重复，悬浮面板保留推荐理由并修复切换时序
• 统计页进入即加载，并修复历史歌曲失效时专辑与艺术家封面缺失
• 修复打开播放列表闪退；播放列表重命名后详情标题立即同步；歌曲详情保存后立即关闭并在后台写入数据库，失败以通知提示
• 支持无盘符的安卓手机 USB 传输（MTP 内部存储/SD 卡），可发送音乐与歌词；扫描改为增量并缓存，逐曲更新状态、明确区分失败并支持重试，写入前预检冲突避免覆盖
• 文件夹目录增删动画加快并保留原生让位过渡，修复收起时样式闪现；修复艺术家卡片设备存在图标不更新
en:
Release Notes
• Added song version management: duplicate audio files are automatically grouped as versions of one song, with switching, setting a preferred version, splitting and undoing in song details; playback skips missing files and missing records can be removed. The library is backed up before upgrade and existing songs are re-associated by title, album and artist credits
• Home recommendations gained "Similar Sound" and "Haven't Heard in a While" sections; the carousel, side cards and "For You" share one queue. "Another batch" counts recent exposure to reduce repeats, and the hover panel keeps its recommendation reason with fixed switching timing
• The statistics page loads immediately on entry, and missing album/artist covers when historical songs are gone are fixed
• Fixed a crash when opening playlists; playlist detail titles now update immediately on rename; song details close right after saving and write to the database in the background, with failures shown as notifications
• Added USB transfer to Android phones without a drive letter (MTP internal storage / SD card) for music and lyrics; scanning is now incremental and cached, per-track status updates immediately, failures are classified with retry support, and conflicts are checked before writing to avoid overwriting
• Folder add/remove animations are faster while keeping native reposition transitions, and a collapse style flash is fixed; fixed the device-presence icon on artist cards not updating
